nodes.alt: Mushrooms decomposing leaf litter on a forest floor
nodes.label: Decomposers

photoDiagram.a11yCaption: Sunlight reaches a flowering plant, which exchanges food and pollen with a pollinator. Separately, leaf litter is broken down by decomposers, returning nutrients to the soil.

flags: Worked example for docs/photo-diagrams.md - reuses the same three already-licensed photos (credited in media/L01/photo-credits.txt) this field was built to replace a hand-coded DomSimulation for (see GENERATION-LOG-style reasoning in docs/simulation-authoring.md's 'CONTROLS: []' section). Two-beat markdown demonstrates revealAt: the decomposer trio (litter/decomp/soil) only appears at beat 1, and the diagram's auto-fit crop is tighter at beat 0 (just the plant/pollinator pair) than at beat 1 - the actual legibility mechanism, not just pacing.
